map.根据钻石直径、高度等尺寸按标准切工公式估算克拉重量，并进行克拉与克、毫克单位换算: Estimate the diamond's carat weight from dimensions such as diameter and height using standard cut formulas, and convert between carat, gram and milligram, assisting diamond valuation and certificate checking.
map.克拉与「分」「克」互换，读懂证书重量。: Convert between carat and points / grams to read certificate weights.
map.不同琢型(round/princess 等)对显大效果的影响。: How different cut shapes (round / princess etc.) affect the face-up size.
map.0.5 克拉是多少分/克: How many points per carat is 0.5 carat
: 1 carat = 0.2 g = 100 points; 0.5 carat = 50 points = 0.1 g. The familiar "50-point diamond" is therefore half a carat.
map.：圆钻 1ct 直径约 6.5mm；同重下公主方/椭圆视觉更大，垫形显小，选琢型: : a 1ct round diamond is about 6.5mm across; at the same weight princess and oval look larger while cushion looks smaller, so cut shape also affects face-up size.
map.不。大克拉稀缺，单价随重量指数上升；同等级 1ct 单价远高于 0.9ct，整克: No. Large carats are scarce and price rises exponentially with weight; at the same grade a 1ct stone costs far more than a 0.9ct one — the full carat is a price jump point.
map.→ 打开钻石克拉计算工具: → Open the Diamond Carat (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.按切型用长度、宽度、深度估算克拉并换算克/毫克/分；圆形只用直径，异形必须填正宽: Estimate carat from length, width and depth for the chosen cut, then convert to grams, milligrams and points. Round cuts use diameter only; fancy cuts require a positive width and no longer default to length = width.
map.圆形：ct = D²×H×0.0061；其他切型：ct = L×W×H×对应系数: Round: ct = D²×H×0.0061. Other cuts: ct = L×W×H×the matching factor (princess 0.0080, emerald 0.0075, oval 0.0062 and so on). Switching to a fancy cut pre-fills width with the length, which you can overwrite with the measured value; a blank, zero or negative width stops the calculation and asks for a measurement.
map.按切型填写长度、宽度与深度估算克拉；异形宽度缺失时不再自动用长度替代。: Enter length, width and depth for the chosen cut; a missing fancy-cut width is no longer silently replaced by the length.
map.：公主方按 L×W×H×0.0080 估算；即使常见为方形，也按用户填写的实际宽: : Princess uses L×W×H×0.0080. Even though it is usually square, the entered width is used and length = width is no longer forced. For oval, marquise, pear and other fancy cuts, a blank width or a value ≤ 0 asks for a measurement and returns no carat result.
map.切型系数是行业经验估算，实际重量受腰围比例、亭部深度、抛光与证书测量口径影响；估: Cut factors are industry rules of thumb. Actual weight also depends on girdle proportions, pavilion depth, polish and the laboratory's measuring convention; the estimate cannot replace a scale or a certificate weight.
map.异形宽度留空会怎样？: What happens if a fancy-cut width is blank?
map.页面会提示该切型需要有效宽度 W（大于 0），不再把长度静默当作宽度。切换切型时: The page asks for a positive width W for that cut instead of silently treating length as width. Switching cut pre-fills the width box from the length, and you can still replace it with the measured value.
map.克拉重量越接近整数越贵？: Is a weight closer to a whole carat more expensive?
map.是，存在「克拉溢价 / 临界重量」现象：0.99 ct 与 1.00 ct 肉眼: Yes, there is a carat premium / magic-weight effect: 0.99 ct and 1.00 ct look almost the same, but the price often jumps 10–30% because 1 ct is a psychological threshold. The same steps occur at 0.49/0.50, 1.49/1.50 and 1.99/2.00. Budget-conscious buyers can choose slightly below the threshold (e.g. 0.95–0.98 ct); after mounting the visual difference is minimal. 1 ct = 0.2 g = 100 points.
